module autovcoder_026830 (
    in1,
    in2,
    out,
    byteIndx,
    bitIndx,
    done,
    work
);
  input [7:0] in1, in2;
  output done;
  output [255:0] out;
  output [31:0] byteIndx;
  output [3:0] bitIndx;

  integer c;
  integer rep;
  integer currValue;
  integer rep2;
  integer currValue2;

  reg [255:0] tempOut;

  integer doneTemp = 0;

  integer index;
  input work;
  always @(in1, in2, work) begin
    c = 0;
    doneTemp = 0;
    rep = in1[6:0];
    currValue = in1[7];
    rep2 = in2[6:0];
    currValue2 = in2[7];
    index = 255;
    repeat (256) begin

      if (rep > 0) begin
        rep = rep - 1;
        tempOut[index] = currValue;
        index = index - 1;
      end
      if (rep == 0 && c == 0) begin
        rep = rep2;
        currValue = currValue2;
        c = 1;
      end
    end

    doneTemp = 1;


  end
  assign byteIndx = (in1[6:0] + in2[6:0]) / 16;
  assign bitIndx = 15 - (in1[6:0] + in2[6:0]) % 16;
  assign out = tempOut;
  assign done = doneTemp;
endmodule
